each_action_role.source: Bottom-crease endpoint half of the one original dashed cut
each_action_role.information: Red distinguishes which part of the existing cut is anchored at the bottom crease. It does not add a second cut or change the straight dashed line.

each_action_role.source: Right-crease endpoint half of the same dashed cut
each_action_role.information: Blue distinguishes the other original crease endpoint. Red and blue meet on the same collinear cutting instruction.
each_action_role.necessity: Second distinct endpoint class; no overlap or dead action.

each_action_role.source: The corresponding colored endpoint class of the original cutting instruction
each_action_role.receiver: A bottom complete V notch, two original connected slants
each_action_role.information: red groups the opposite bottom border notch with its partner as if the two cut endpoints generated two independent boundary-notch orbits.
each_action_role.necessity: One complete V counterpart, retaining its exact geometry and all uncut edge portions.

human_semantics_both_readings: Only the already explicit dashed cutting instruction and A invalid boundary notches are colored. Instruction color is not a paper ink condition. The bands, layer order, folds and correct uncolored E are untouched; E remains the internal diamond under either instruction/annotation reading or an intrinsic color reading of the impossible A option.
conciseness: One disjoint action per actual source class or counterpart. No points, auxiliary lines, labels, fills or fold/cut additions; no thickness changes.
